items.question: Do you keep logs?
items.answer: No. We do not store connection metadata or browsing history on our servers.

items.question: How much do I get on the free plan?
items.answer: 30 GB per month. Get your config from the Telegram Bot in about 1 min.

items.question: Do I have to pay?
items.answer: The free plan costs nothing via the Telegram Bot. The dedicated Family plan is available — contact us for pricing and setup. Standard and Premium will be announced later.

items.answer: Use common clients like Hiddify, v2rayNG, v2rayN, Sing-box, and more — import your link and connect.
